title: Deduplicate contacts without losing distinct people
prompt:
Contact merge rule: equal email ignoring case and outer spaces identifies a duplicate; company alone does not. Records: A=Lee@Example.test at Acme; B=' lee@example.test ' at Acme; C=pat@example.test at Acme. Keep the alphabetically earliest ID in a duplicate group.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. keep_ids: alphabetically sorted array; merge_into: object mapping removed ID to kept ID.
remediation_hints: Use a verified identity key, not a shared company, to merge records.
